method: 63 single launches: seven representative placements/approach positions × three current silo variants × Dog/Roller/Moth, one at a time. Production EnemyPreview gait, MissilePreview admission, boost/coast/committed-intercept guidance, swept contact and fixed claims;1/120-second steps. Every other launch is disabled. A hit demonstrates that finite placement/trajectory, not all positions/times. Committed-intercept corner misses may be valid outcomes and do not justify scenery removal.
